main_idea: Distillation lifts two model families to about +21% net GDPval win-loss margin.
ideas: Nemotron student beats base by +20.9% net win-loss margin
Qwen family reproduces the gain at +21.4% margin
Wins outnumber losses 123 to 77 on 220 tasks
Training used no GDPval eval tasks
summary: A clear two-row stat layout is buried under a slogan headline, a category tag, a wordy subtitle, and a win-loss bar chart that drifts from the two-family claim; nothing essential is missing.
